levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation here: a relation link; «محمد بن الحسن» joins him by «قالا» as one level
two «جميعا» convergences are written as co-transmitter levels with no «ح», so the report is one group
«سمعت أبا عبد الله يقول» names the Imam after the chain: imam_in_text, written as the report names him
«رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا» is a blessing and is left out
